description: This file contains internal interfaces and classes related to Transport Connection features in the Orleans.Networking.Shared namespace. It defines feature interfaces like IConnectionIdFeature, IConnectionTransportFeature, and classes like TransportConnection implementing multiple connection-related features and managing feature collections within a networking context.

classes.name: IConnectionIdFeature
classes.description: Defines a feature that exposes a connection identifier string.

classes.name: IConnectionTransportFeature
classes.description: Defines a feature that exposes a duplex pipe for transport.

classes.name: IConnectionItemsFeature
classes.description: Provides a property to access connection-specific items as a dictionary.

classes.name: IMemoryPoolFeature
classes.description: Provides a property to access a memory pool.

classes.name: TransportConnection
classes.description: A class implementing multiple connection features and collection management for a network transport connection.

methods.name: FastReset
methods.description: Resets internal feature references to default state.

methods.name: ResetFeatureCollection
methods.description: Resets the feature collection, clearing extras and incrementing revision.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureGet
methods.description: Retrieves an extra feature from the stored list by type.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureSet
methods.description: Adds or updates an extra feature in the stored list.
